title: $1,000 in each since 2015: who wins?
caption:
Bitcoin, stocks, gold or cash? $1,000 in each in 2015.
Winner: Bitcoin, now about {growth:BTC-USD:2015-01-02}.
Last: Cash, about $1,000.
(Price growth only, no dividends.)
sources: Yahoo Finance price history (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One thousand dollars in each, back in 2015. Guess the winner.
Watch the race. Every bar is one thousand dollars, growing year by year.
Bitcoin wins, at about {growth:BTC-USD:2015-01-02}. Cash comes last, at about $1,000.
Which one would you have picked?
